build.//: The development profile is the one to demo on. RevenueCat's Test Store deliberately refuses to run in a release build — it alerts and crashes rather than let test purchases grant real entitlements — so a preview or production build cannot show the paywall until real store keys exist. It also keeps __DEV__ true, which is what src/lib/purchases.js requires before it will reach for the test key at all.
build.//preview: A self-contained APK with the JS bundled in, for handing to someone without Metro. Subscriptions are OFF in this profile by design: __DEV__ is false and no platform key is configured, so purchases.js configures nothing rather than crashing. Useful for showing the rest of the app, not the paywall.
